Players Committee card image of [[Han's Dice (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “If Han or your gambler is in battle (with no Jedi), draw destiny: (0-2) subtract that amount from opponent's total battle destiny; (3-4) cancel the game text of a character participating in battle (if any); (5+) opponent loses all immunity to attrition (if any) this battle.” Uploaded unchanged.
